detail.title: 8MP IR Fixed-focal Eyeball WizMind Network Camera
detail.overview: Compare Favourite IPC-HDW4841EM-S 8MP IR Fixed-focal Eyeball WizMind Network Camera Key Points • High-Quality Imaging with 8MP Resolution • Enhanced Deep Learning-Based Human and Vehicle Classification • Leveraging Facial Data to Enhance Business Analytics Accuracy • Built-in Mic for Real-Time Audio Security • IP67 Ratings for Protection Against Harsh Environments Sales Enquiry Datasheet

General.Min. Illumination: 0.007 lux@F1.4 (Color, 30 IRE) 0.0007 lux@F1.4 (B/W, 30 IRE) 0 lux (Illuminator on)
General.Field of View: 2.8 mm: Horizontal:107°; vertical: 56°; diagonal: 127° 3.6 mm: Horizontal:84°; vertical: 47°; diagonal: 97°
General.IVS (Perimeter Protection): Tripwire, intrusion (support the classification and accurate detection of vehicle and human)
General.SMD 3.0: Less false alarm, longer detection distance
General.Face Detection: Face detection; track; snapshot; snapshot optimization; optimal face snapshot upload; face enhancement; face exposure; face snapshot set as face or one-inch photo; 3 snapshot strategies (real-time snapshot, optimization snapshot, and quality priority); face angle filter; optimization time setting
General.Smart Search: Work together with Smart NVR to perform refine intelligent search, event extraction and merging to event videos
General.Video Compression: H.265; H.264; H.264H; H.264B; MJPEG (only supported by the sub stream)
General.Video Frame Rate: Main stream: 3840 × 2160 @ (1–25/30) fps Sub stream 1: 704 × 576 @ (1–25 fps)/704 × 480 @ (1–30 fps) Sub stream 2: 1920 × 1080 @ (1–25/30 fps) Sub stream 3: 1280 × 720 @ (1–25/30 fps) *The values above are the max. frame rates of each stream; for multiple streams, the values will be subjected to the total encoding capacity
General.Video Bit Rate: H.264: 3 kbps–8192 kbps H.265: 3 kbps–8192 kbps
General.White Balance: Auto; natural; street lamp; outdoor; manual; regional custom
General.Alarm Event: No SD card, SD card full, SD card error, network disconnection, IP conflict, illegal access, motion detection, video tampering, tripwire, intrusion, scene changing, audio detection, voltage detection, face detection, SMD and security exception
General.Network Protocol: IPv4; IPv6; HTTP;TCP; UDP; ARP; RTP; RTSP; RTCP; RTMP; SMTP; FTP; SFTP; DHCP; DNS; DDNS; QoS; UPnP; NTP; Multicast; ICMP; IGMP; NFS; PPPoE; SNMP
General.Security: Digest; WSSE; Account lockout; Security logs; IP/MAC filtering; Generation and importing of X.509 certification; syslog; HTTPS; 802.1x; Trusted boot; Trusted execution; Trusted upgrade
General.Interoperability: ONVIF (Profile S/Profile G/Profile T); CGI; P2P; Milestone; Genetec
General.Storage: FTP; SFTP; Micro SD card (support max. 512 G); NAS
General.Certifications: CE-LVD:EN62368-1; CE-EMC:Electromagnetic Compatibility Directive 2014/30/EU; FCC:47 CFR FCC Part 15, Subpart B; UL/CUL:UL62368-1 & CAN/CSA C22.2 No. 62368-1-14;
General.Power Consumption: Basic: 4.3 W (12 VDC); 4.9 W (PoE) Max. (WDR + IR intensity + Intelligence): 7.6 W (12 VDC); 8.9 W (PoE)
